alignments.note: Impersonal verb takes the supplied subject and the modal frame 'must needs' under rules 7 and 9.
Subject and auxiliary ride with the finite verb; head on the lexical verb per rules 9 and 17.
Substantival article with its own supplied determiner; head on the nominal word per rule 22, the case preposition riding along per rule 21.
Article displaced by the possessive 'my' on the genitive pronoun, rule 20.
